profile_text.body:
OpenAI is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA. Its website is chatgpt.com. The company describes ChatGPT as an AI tool for chat, work, creation, and coding, offering answers, writing, image creation, task completion, and coding in one place, available for free or as an app. It states that chats may be reviewed and used to improve its AI models.

The product records list ChatGPT, OpenAI API / GPT models, OpenAI Playground / Dashboard, Operator, DALL-E, Sora, and Whisper API. Notes associated with these products mention usage-based cost escalation risk for the API and Playground, credential exposure and action authorization risk for Operator, IP provenance relevance for DALL-E, provenance and disclosure relevance for Sora, and API data retention policy for Whisper API.

Court records show OpenAI named in cases across several federal district courts, including the Western District of Pennsylvania, Northern District of Florida, Northern District of California, Southern District of New York, Eastern District of Texas, and Eastern District of Arkansas. Parties include The Seattle Times Company, wikiHow, Inc., and the United States. Named OpenAI entities include OpenAI Group PBC, OpenAI Inc, OpenAI OpCo, LLC, and OpenAI Foundation. The records also list 281 California law exposure entries. MCP server listings include ai.com.mcp/openai-tools for image and audio generation, and several agents from ai.getvda and ai.smithery for orchestration, structured output, paper search, and stock quotes.
